instruction: A candid documentary photograph from a wide, high angle captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpeted floor and white walls. The man in the dark grey t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, leaning forward to place both hands on the chest of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2). The woman (R2) stands upright on the right, facing him with a neutral expression and her arms at her sides. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead lighting, casting soft shadows on the red carpet.
elements: R1 leans forward and places both hands on R2's chest
R2 stands upright and receives R1's hand contact on her chest
R2 keeps her arms at her sides rather than touching R1
